trails.title: 太空探索
trails.intro: 从第一次出舱到空间站：人类怎样把身体、工具和目光一点点送出大气层。
trails.intro_en: From the first spacewalk to the Space Station: how the body, tools and gaze were sent beyond the atmosphere, one step at a time.

trails.title: 灾难与调查
trails.intro: 从旧金山地震到切尔诺贝利：灾难不是瞬间，而是预警、判断、救援和调查组成的长链。
trails.intro_en: From the San Francisco earthquake to Chernobyl: a disaster is not a moment but a chain of warning, judgment, rescue and investigation.

trails.title: 工程与城市
trails.intro: 从运河、铁塔到金门大桥：现代城市不是自然长出来的，是一次次工程决策把水、人和速度重新安排。
trails.intro_en: From canals and towers to the Golden Gate: the modern city is not natural; it is a series of engineering decisions that rearrange water, people and speed.

trails.title: 铁路与工业
trails.intro: 从机车一号到伦敦地铁：钢轨把时间表写进城市，也把事故写进公共记忆；工业则把机器送进日常。
trails.intro_en: From Locomotion No. 1 to the London Underground: rails write timetables into the city and accidents into public memory; industry brings machines into daily life.

trails.title: 艺术与图像
trails.intro: 从摄影术的前五十年到街头与无名者：图像不只是作品，也是谁被看见、谁被留下的证据。
trails.intro_en: From photography's first fifty years to the street and the unnamed: an image is not only a work but evidence of who was seen and who was left out.
